[[Scythe of the Kinslayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from the [[Chest of Burrows]], which appears after killing [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] in [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bonecage Scythe]].
